description: What to do about a stock after reading a news alert or a company filing.

news_impact.description: For this company, is the news bearish, bullish or neutral?

options.bearish: Bad news: likely to push the stock down
options.bullish: Good news: likely to push the stock up
options.neutral: No clear effect on the stock

action.description: Given this news, what should happen to the position in this stock?

options.hold: Nothing important changed; keep the position as it is
options.watch: Something may matter; look again in a few days
options.trim: Bad news for the business; sell part of the position
options.add: Clearly good news for the business; buy more

tell_owner.description: Is this news important enough to message the owner right now?
